items.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Adele Girard played harp and was usually part of his band.

ctx.x: Adele Girard played harp and was usually part of his band. But and then I discovered Nick’s and the whole point was also, see you could get in, a high school kid could get in there pretty easily, it was very inexpensive. It got to be, perhaps the music was secondary and in fact what a great place for a cheap date. So I do remember that that was part of the picture.
